title: SoMA: Singular Value Decomposed Minor Components Adaptation for Domain Generalizable Representation Learning
mechanism: LoRA initialised on the minor singular components of each pretrained weight, with generalisable blocks frozen and an annealing weight decay; keeps the major pretrained directions intact.
evidence: Top of the Rein++ DGSS comparison: 68.2 mIoU average GTAV to Cityscapes/BDD/Mapillary (Rein 64.9).
adaptation: Principled PF for ResNet-34: reshape conv kernels to (out, in*k*k), SVD, train only the bottom-r components in layer3/4, freeze stem/layer1/2; anneal weight decay. Also the DG arm for any ViT encoder from D24.
min_experiment: SoMA-ResNet34 vs PF, 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 inactive IoU, E1 crack relF1@2, test crack IoU. Kill: no gain > 0.02 over PF on either E1 metric.
prior_overlap: Partial: PF (freeze then 0.1x lr) tests the same aim, but not SVD minor-component tuning. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: A finer form of PF encoder preservation: SVD on reshaped ResNet-34 conv kernels (or a DINOv2/v3 backbone), tune minor components only.
alt_notes.min_experiment: SoMA-ResNet-34 vs PF, 3 seeds; kill if E1 inactive IoU < PF and crack unchanged.
